definition: Angry because something seems unfair or wrong.
author: Lewis Carroll
quote: Alice began in a loud, indignant voice, but she stopped hastily, for the White Rabbit cried out, “Silence in the court!”
example_sentence: She was indignant at being blamed for the broken vase.
